svg.aria-label: How a session is contained: the harness assembles a throwaway runtime holding only the closure of skills and one figure, the session answers through the Skill tool and a schema, and the run writes the prediction, the skill trace and the cost audit; gold reaches only scoring
svg.text: pins one version of each skill
the answer must fit the schema
gold meets the prediction only here, after the session
prediction.json + gold → analysis.json: layers S, 1 and 2
Dashed red: what a session never gets. Files are never copied in, and a runtime holding one is refused; tools are removed by name.
one example, one session: a runtime is assembled for it, used once, and deleted
